guidelines.listings_3: No animal cruelty, in photos or in practice.
guidelines.listings_4: Accurate breed, price and photos of the actual animal.
guidelines.listings_6: Mark a listing as unavailable as soon as the animal is gone.
guidelines.profiles_1: No impersonating another person, shelter or business.
guidelines.comments_2: No fake reviews. Review only people you actually dealt with.

guidelines.enforcement: What happens when you break them
guidelines.enforcement_intro: Every upheld report counts as a strike against your account.
guidelines.strike_3: Third within 90 days, or any scam, animal welfare or prohibited-animal case: the account is deactivated.

help.faq_add_pet_after: . The form is eight short steps — the basics, where the pet is, photos, health, personality, anything extra, veterinary details, and a review of the lot. You will be asked to sign in first if you have not already. Nothing is saved until you submit on the last step, and you can move between steps freely before then.
help.faq_update_pet_after: . You will see the same eight steps with everything already filled in. Saving replaces the whole listing, so leave the fields you are not changing exactly as they are — including the cover photo, which stays as it is unless you pick a new one.
